_about: Single source of truth for timing. animation.py (cameras, events, captions) and voiceover.py read this file. Times are seconds from the start of the video at 30 fps. Edit a line's 'start' or a shot's boundaries here and re-run; nothing else needs changing.

lines.text: February 1959. Nine hikers skied into Russia's Ural Mountains.
lines.tts: February, nineteen fifty-nine. Nine hikers skied into Russia's Ural Mountains.

lines.text: Weeks later, searchers found their tent half-buried in snow, cut open from the inside.
lines.tts: Weeks later, searchers found their tent half-buried in snow, cut open from the inside.

lines.text: Footprints, in socks or bare feet, led down the slope, toward the trees.
lines.tts: Footprints, in socks or bare feet, led down the slope, toward the trees.

lines.text: Investigators blamed a "compelling natural force", and closed the case.
lines.tts: Investigators blamed a compelling natural force, and closed the case.

lines.text: Decades of theories followed. Secret weapons tests. Strange lights in the sky.
lines.tts: Decades of theories followed. Secret weapons tests. Strange lights in the sky.

lines.text: In 2021, scientists modelled the leading explanation: a delayed slab avalanche.
lines.tts: In twenty twenty-one, scientists modelled the leading explanation: a delayed slab avalanche.

lines.text: To pitch the tent, the hikers had cut into the slope.
lines.tts: To pitch the tent, the hikers had cut into the slope.

lines.text: Wind piled snow above the cut, until, hours later, a slab may have broken loose.
lines.tts: Wind piled snow above the cut, until, hours later, a slab may have broken loose.

lines.text: In 2020, Russian prosecutors also blamed an avalanche. But not everyone is convinced.
lines.tts: In twenty twenty, Russian prosecutors also blamed an avalanche. But not everyone is convinced.

lines.text: So, what really happened at Dyatlov Pass?
